searchText: is this PR to be included for next withdrawals/capella devnet? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3165 cc: <@412614104222531604> <@199561711278227457> <@360491619402776577> <@602753420033785856> <@680234424037670912> <@755590043632140352> more of a CL concern we haven't implemented that yet cc <@363800010518822915> who's tackling that We'd like to have a small scale devnet next week and a public one ~16th Jan. So I guess based on ACD this week we can discuss scope for both? (Ideally same scope for both) we could probably push out the small scale devnet even end of this week. depending on the client teams and their state of implementations I can have that implemented by end of the day but I probably wont want to merge it to capella until spec test I think the consensus spec + test release is this friday so maybe we can wait until earlier next week to include that change Where could I find detailed geth setup instructions for withdrawals-devnet-1? https://github.com/ethpandaops/withdrawals-testnet/tree/master/withdrawal-devnet-1/custom_config_data no special instructions needed, just init with the correct genesis `geth init genesis.json` and run thanks, which geth branch should I use? lightclients/withdrawals-timestamp how does it work with bootnodes / discovery btw? it uses the same dht as mainnet? Bootnodes you need to specify from the above configuration repo For anyone stumped why geth doesn't connect peers, you also need to set --networkid to connect
